Requirement: Register and authenticate a participant using a verified email or phone contact.
Acceptance criterion: Duplicate normalized contacts are rejected; credentials never appear in responses; recovery uses verified channels.

Requirement: Support participant facilitator and administrator roles on one account.
Acceptance criterion: Public registration cannot grant admin; role switching preserves the same user identity.

Requirement: Require administrator approval before a facilitator operates a cohort.
Acceptance criterion: Pending or suspended facilitator cannot create or manage cohorts.

Requirement: Collect a basic profile with optional demographics.
Acceptance criterion: Name and contact suffice to register; optional demographic fields can be left blank.

Requirement: Manage partner records and facilitator affiliations.
Acceptance criterion: An approved facilitator can serve several partners; affiliation is checked during assignment.

Requirement: Create a cohort with partner district curriculum dates and delivery mode.
Acceptance criterion: Creation assigns an approved lead atomically; invalid date ranges are rejected.

Requirement: Allow a lead and assistant facilitators with scoped access.
Acceptance criterion: One active lead exists; unrelated facilitators receive no cohort data.

Requirement: Join through a revocable expiring cohort code or link after preview.
Acceptance criterion: Preview shows cohort partner and facilitator; expiry and capacity are checked on confirmed join.

Requirement: Retain a separate enrollment for each participant cohort pair.
Acceptance criterion: Duplicate join returns the existing enrollment; a new cohort creates separate progress and answers.

Requirement: Manage planned active completed cancelled and archived cohort states.
Acceptance criterion: Completed state requires reviewed eligibility or explicit authorized correction; cancelled cohorts do not silently count as completed.

Requirement: Schedule physical online or hybrid sessions using local time.
Acceptance criterion: Physical needs venue; online needs valid Google Meet link; hybrid needs both; invalid end time is rejected.

Requirement: Open Google Meet through an external link.
Acceptance criterion: Join opens the configured Meet URL; application creates no video room and claims no automatic attendance.

Requirement: Record present absent or excused attendance for eligible enrolled participants.
Acceptance criterion: Missing is unrecorded; cross-cohort attendance is rejected; bulk changes are reviewed before save.

Requirement: Finalize or cancel a session independently of lesson work.
Acceptance criterion: Finalizing attendance does not complete outstanding participant Life Work.

Requirement: Deliver the approved 15-lesson workbook with its original component structure.
Acceptance criterion: Curriculum owner checks every lesson against the source including scripture vocabulary activities and Life Work.

Requirement: Provide separate participant and facilitator lesson views.
Acceptance criterion: Participant payloads never contain facilitator-only guidance.

Requirement: Save drafts and submit typed workbook responses.
Acceptance criterion: Validation errors preserve typed input; success confirms server save; reloading retrieves the saved draft.

Requirement: Record discussions without forcing written answers.
Acceptance criterion: Facilitator confirmation can complete a discussion component for selected participants without creating invented response text.

Requirement: Complete a lesson only when its defined requirements are satisfied.
Acceptance criterion: Opening the lesson is insufficient; submission updates response and progress atomically.

Requirement: Allow authorized exceptional completion with a reason.
Acceptance criterion: Override stores approver time and reason; override counts are distinguishable in reporting.

Requirement: Freeze published curriculum and bind each cohort to one version.
Acceptance criterion: Editing published content is rejected; a new version leaves existing cohort responses intact.

Requirement: Provide the 24-question career quiz with ratings from 1 to 5.
Acceptance criterion: Missing answers or values outside 1 to 5 cannot be submitted as complete.

Requirement: Calculate and display all six category sums with ties preserved.
Acceptance criterion: Known fixtures match workbook mapping; four answers per category yield a score from 4 to 20.

Requirement: Preserve assessment attempts and scoring version.
Acceptance criterion: Retake creates a new attempt without changing earlier submitted answers; latest submitted attempt is the displayed default.

Requirement: Create one or several projects within a cohort.
Acceptance criterion: Each project captures problem idea and community benefit; membership belongs to the same cohort.

Requirement: Assign team members and curriculum roles.
Acceptance criterion: Leader secretary spokesperson resourcer and member are supported; another cohort enrollment is rejected.

Requirement: Capture goals actions tasks resources responsible people others involved and timeframes.
Acceptance criterion: Task assignee and linked goal belong to the same project; contradictory dates are rejected.

Requirement: Track project stages and task status with conflict protection.
Acceptance criterion: A stale update receives a conflict and does not overwrite a newer edit.

Requirement: Capture individual project evaluation using approved workbook fields.
Acceptance criterion: Ratings use the workbook 0 to 3 range; final personal reflection remains separate.

Requirement: Confirm project and participant programme completion.
Acceptance criterion: Facilitator sees unmet conditions before confirmation; attendance alone is insufficient.

Requirement: Provide facilitator dashboards for assigned cohorts only.
Acceptance criterion: Roster attendance current cohort lesson and individual completion agree with source records.

Requirement: Provide admin filters and programme summaries.
Acceptance criterion: Year region district partner facilitator and cohort filters share documented denominator definitions.

Requirement: Export authorized programme records to CSV.
Acceptance criterion: Export matches filters excludes private payloads and neutralizes spreadsheet formula cells.

Requirement: Restrict personal response contents by fixed component visibility.
Acceptance criterion: Private means participant only; facilitator sees completion metadata; admin report never includes private text.

Requirement: Authorize every request by identity role and resource membership.
Acceptance criterion: Negative API tests cover foreign cohort enrollment project and private response identifiers.

Requirement: Enforce cross-cohort version and assessment consistency in the database.
Acceptance criterion: Invalid direct writes fail constraints or triggers and leave no partial completion state.

Requirement: Support mobile screens keyboard navigation labels and clear save states.
Acceptance criterion: At 360 CSS pixels no horizontal overflow; key workflows work without a mouse; errors identify the field.

Requirement: Meet provisional low-bandwidth and response targets.
Acceptance criterion: Compressed initial participant route <=500 KB excluding optional media; p95 ordinary API <=1 second at 50 concurrent authenticated test users on agreed staging hardware.

Requirement: Back up database and prove a restore before pilot.
Acceptance criterion: Proposed pilot RPO <=24 hours and RTO <=4 hours demonstrated using an isolated restore and recorded run.

Requirement: Preserve submitted records and prevent silent overwrites or duplicate effects.
Acceptance criterion: Retries of join attendance save and quiz submission create no duplicate enrollment or scores; stale revisions return conflict.

Requirement: Keep domain services migrations and automated regression tests modular.
Acceptance criterion: Fresh database can migrate and seed approved content; CI checks complete before release.

Requirement: Minimize demographic data and keep personal content out of logs.
Acceptance criterion: Logs contain record IDs outcome and timing but no passwords tokens contact values or reflection payloads.
